model.name: migration.assertOnlyDeclaredFieldsDiffer
model.description: Every migration/dedup run asserts a before/after differential: only its declared target fields differ, identity (member name, uuid) + provenance (joinedAt, createdAt) byte-identical unless targeted, fail-closed on any out-of-scope change, and refuses to run without the assertion.
model.note: class/method=null - architect wires the migration-differential harness (reuse PAIR-2 byte-identity shape) on build-go.
